prompt: Create a full-body, high-detail anime illustration of an elegant young woman named Friedelinde standing in a sunlit traditional Japanese garden courtyard beside a koi pond and wooden temple-style architecture. She has a slender graceful figure, fair skin, warm golden-brown eyes, and very long flowing light chestnut brown hair with soft waves, loose strands, tiny floral hair ornaments, and delicate dangling earrings. She wears a refined asymmetrical kimono-inspired couture outfit: one bare shoulder with a cream-white wrapped bodice, a single wide draped sleeve on her right arm, translucent layered outer panels, black and bronze hakama-style wide trousers, a dark obi belt tied with ribbons, tassels, and a large white flower ornament. The clothing is decorated with gold trim and white lily-like floral embroidery, especially on the long sleeve and sheer skirt panels; keep the look elegant and artistic, not explicit. Her pose is poised and gentle, one hand relaxed downward and the other lightly extending the long sleeve outward, gazing softly to the side with a calm expression. Set the scene in late-afternoon warm sunlight with dappled shadows from trees, stone paving, a stone lantern, rocks, pond water, garden plants, and a traditional wooden veranda in the background. Use a luxurious soft anime art style with painterly lighting, delicate linework, realistic fabric translucency, flowing hair motion, shallow depth of field, warm highlights, cinematic composition, vertical 2:3 framing, ultra-detailed, beautiful, serene, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张全身、高细节的动漫插画，描绘一位优雅的年轻女性 Friedelinde，她站在阳光明媚的传统日式庭院中，身旁是锦鲤池和木质寺庙风格的建筑。她身材苗条优美，皮肤白皙，有着温暖的金棕色眼眸，以及非常长且飘逸的 浅栗棕色 波浪卷发，发丝柔顺，点缀着微小的花朵发饰，并佩戴着精致的垂坠耳环。她身着精致的非对称和服风格高级定制服装：一侧露肩，配有奶油白色裹胸，右臂有一只宽大的垂坠袖子，外层为半透明叠层，下身穿着黑色与青铜色袴式阔腿裤，腰间系着带有丝带、流苏和大型白色花朵装饰的深色腰带。服装装饰着金色镶边和百合花般的白色刺绣，特别是在长袖和半透明裙摆上；整体风格保持优雅艺术，避免露骨。她的姿态从容温柔，一只手自然下垂，另一只手轻轻向外伸展长袖，侧头凝视，神情宁静。场景设定在午后温暖的阳光下，树影斑驳，背景包含石板路、石灯笼、岩石、池水、园林植物以及传统的木质走廊。采用奢华柔和的动漫艺术风格，结合绘画感光影、细腻的线条、逼真的织物半透明感、飘逸的发丝动态、浅景深、温暖的高光、电影级构图、2:3 竖构图，超高细节，唯美，宁静，无文字，无水印。
